headline: OAK @ HOU matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is OAK 4.34 at HOU 4.63, with a projected total of 8.97. NRFI probability dropped -12.7%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Batter research is strongest for Jeremy Peña, Tyler Soderstrom, Yordan Alvarez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Collin Price, Colby Thomas because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
